newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Tyre sets up subsidiary in southern China.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Tyre sets up subsidiary in southern China.

text.p: China's Shanghai Tyre and Rubber Co Ltd has set up a subsidiary in southern China as part of efforts to expand its annual sales to 10 billion yuan ($1.2 billion) by 2000, officials and state media said on Tuesday.
The Haikou Haihua Tyre Co Ltd, set up on Sunday, was created after Shanghai Tyre purchased Haikou Tyre Plant last November, an official of Shanghai Tyre told Reuters by telephone.

The subsidiary in Haikou, capital of China's southern Hainan province, was expected to make 15 million yuan in profits and to generate 230 million yuan of turnover in 1997, the China Chemical Industry News said. It gave no further details.
